node.title: AQB averaged-family certificate semantics
node.statement: If an AQB c=2 certificate specifies a finite nonempty family at sigma*, shared quotient/fiber data, reusable box-charge data, and a transfer map from each member to its list witness, and the certificate predicates verify those fields, then aqb_c2_average_family holds.
node.attack_surface: definition-checking soundness for finite averaged-family certificates
node.falsifier: a verifying AQB averaged-family certificate whose family is empty, not in the c=2 quotient-box geometry, or lacks the asserted shared quotient/transfer structure
